_policy: Repo-root allowlist for the CI 'security' job (.github/workflows/ci.yml). CI fails on any High or Critical advisory NOT listed below. To accept a known, currently-unfixable advisory, add its GHSA or npm advisory ID to 'allowlist' with a one-line justification and a review-by date in the matching '_notes' entry. Re-review every accepted entry at each launch; remove it once an upstream fix or override ships. Do not lower the threshold below High to silence noise.
